title: Diploid vs Haploid
text: Diploid (2n) means the cell has pairs of chromosomes (46 in humans). Haploid (n) means the cell has only one set of chromosomes, which is half the diploid number.

title: Calculate the Haploid Number
text: If 2n = 46, then n = 46 / 2 = 23. Gametes (sperm and eggs) are always haploid so that fertilization restores the diploid number.
